sources.title: Osakra/Project-Norn-V18-9B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Our goal with Project Norn is to help advance open-source AI by exploring how fine-tuned compact backbones (Qwen3.8-9B-Distill) paired with transparent step-by-step deliberation and neuro-symbolic associative memory concepts can deliver strong mathematical, algorithmic, and relational reasoning on accessible local hardware.
